resultNote: Tool features and pricing can change; check current details. Gemini may have age or school restrictions.

tools.name: Focustown
tools.blurb: A virtual cafe for body-doubling, focus timers, and streaks.
tools.firstStep: Join one 25-minute study room and set a single goal.

tools.name: LifeAt
tools.blurb: Customizable study spaces with sounds, timers, planning, and co-working.
tools.firstStep: Choose a study space and use one Pomodoro session.

tools.name: Structured
tools.blurb: A visual timeline that combines tasks, habits, and a Pomodoro timer.
tools.firstStep: Add tomorrow’s classes and one study task to your timeline.

tools.name: Google Calendar
tools.blurb: A quick way to track deadlines, events, reminders, and shared schedules.
tools.firstStep: Add your next test or deadline and set a reminder.

tools.name: Notion
tools.blurb: A flexible home for notes, lists, tables, and project trackers.
tools.firstStep: Make one simple page for a current project; skip elaborate setup.

tools.name: Quizlet
tools.blurb: Flashcards and practice modes for active recall and memorizing.
tools.firstStep: Turn five key terms from your notes into flashcards.

tools.name: Gemini
tools.blurb: An AI assistant for explanations, summaries, brainstorming, and practice questions.
tools.firstStep: Ask it to explain one hard idea, then check the answer against class materials.
